name: Wilderness of Judea

related_people.name: John
related_people.role: preached repentance and baptized here, preparing the way for Jesus

description: The rugged desert region near the Dead Sea where John the Baptist lived and preached, calling people to repentance and baptizing them in the Jordan (Matthew 3:1-6).
family_friendly_summary: The Wilderness of Judea was the rugged, dry land near the Dead Sea where John the Baptist lived and preached. Crowds came out to hear him call them to turn back to God and be baptized in the Jordan River, as he pointed ahead to Jesus.

geo.note: Approximate: the arid country between the Judean hills and the Dead Sea.
